The Horse Tamer has no name, or perhaps he once did, but has long since forgotten. He is followed everywhere by an old horse fond of dancing, so others mockingly call him the Horse Tamer. 

He was an ordinary man, once taken in by Aureate Pavilion. Unfortunately, he had no talent for martial arts. So they sent him to the Cocoon House, where he became a test subject for Sleeping Puppet experiments. Clearly, he lacked any special traits, he failed the drug trial and was quickly discarded in the mass grave. But just as he was about to die, a warhorse saved him. 

The Horse Tamer has never truly felt alive. He has no morals, no sense of right or wrong, no desire to live, and no fear of death. The only real thing in his life may have been that warhorse. He's always wondered, why did the horse save him?
